# NEW 2026-11-21 v10.5 Worker 4: Act III Atlantic Hegemony & Act IV Nostos / Imperium Bicephalum (oe_elr_, Slot 74). Generated by gen_elysia_return.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Initialize telemetry counters cleanly once on first Act III/IV tick.
oe_elr_init_counters = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_init_done } }
		set_variable = oe_elr_init_done
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_nostos_stage } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_elr_nostos_stage value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_quarantine_state } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_elr_quarantine_state value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_silver_intercepts } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_elr_silver_intercepts value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved value = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Advance Nostos campaign stage (1..4) and mirror to global state for situation/telemetry.
oe_elr_set_nostos_stage = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_elr_nostos_stage value = $STAGE$ }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_elr_nostos_stage value = $STAGE$ }
}

# Grant oe_elr_cb_nostos_reclamation against current holders of Constantinople, Rome, Gibraltar, and Azores.
oe_elr_grant_nostos_cbs = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			location:constantinople = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = {
					NOT = { this = root }
					NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = root }
				}
			}
		}
		location:constantinople = {
			owner = { save_scope_as = oe_elr_cb_holder }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_casus_belli_of_type_on = {
						type = casus_belli:oe_elr_cb_nostos_reclamation
						target = scope:oe_elr_cb_holder
					}
				}
			}
			add_casus_belli = {
				target = scope:oe_elr_cb_holder
				type = casus_belli:oe_elr_cb_nostos_reclamation
				years = 25
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			location:rome = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = {
					NOT = { this = root }
					NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = root }
				}
			}
		}
		location:rome = {
			owner = { save_scope_as = oe_elr_cb_rome_holder }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_casus_belli_of_type_on = {
						type = casus_belli:oe_elr_cb_nostos_reclamation
						target = scope:oe_elr_cb_rome_holder
					}
				}
			}
			add_casus_belli = {
				target = scope:oe_elr_cb_rome_holder
				type = casus_belli:oe_elr_cb_nostos_reclamation
				years = 25
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			location:gibraltar = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = {
					NOT = { this = root }
					NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = root }
				}
			}
		}
		location:gibraltar = {
			owner = { save_scope_as = oe_elr_cb_gib_holder }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_casus_belli_of_type_on = {
						type = casus_belli:oe_elr_cb_nostos_reclamation
						target = scope:oe_elr_cb_gib_holder
					}
				}
			}
			add_casus_belli = {
				target = scope:oe_elr_cb_gib_holder
				type = casus_belli:oe_elr_cb_nostos_reclamation
				years = 25
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			location:angra = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = {
					NOT = { this = root }
					NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = root }
				}
			}
		}
		location:angra = {
			owner = { save_scope_as = oe_elr_cb_az_holder }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_casus_belli_of_type_on = {
						type = casus_belli:oe_elr_cb_nostos_reclamation
						target = scope:oe_elr_cb_az_holder
					}
				}
			}
			add_casus_belli = {
				target = scope:oe_elr_cb_az_holder
				type = casus_belli:oe_elr_cb_nostos_reclamation
				years = 25
			}
		}
	}
}

# Formally open Act IV Nostos expedition & discover Atlantic/Mediterranean approaches.
oe_elr_begin_nostos = {
	oe_elr_init_counters = yes
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_elr_nostos_declared value = 1 }
	oe_elr_set_nostos_stage = { STAGE = 1 }
	discover_area = area:azores_sea_area
	discover_area = area:western_mediterranean_sea_area
	discover_area = area:central_mediterranean_sea_area
	discover_area = area:aegean_sea_area
	location:ponta_delgada = { discover_location = root }
	location:angra = { discover_location = root }
	location:gibraltar = { discover_location = root }
	location:constantinople = { discover_location = root }
	location:rome = { discover_location = root }
	oe_elr_grant_nostos_cbs = yes
	add_prestige = 15
	add_navy_tradition = 10
}

# Silver fleet interception execution (increments counter, awards treasure, applies Iberian friction).
oe_elr_silver_fleet_intercept = {
	oe_elr_init_counters = yes
	change_variable = { name = oe_elr_silver_intercepts add = 1 }
	add_gold = 450
	add_prestige = 10
	add_navy_tradition = 8
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:SPA }
		c:SPA = {
			add_opinion = { modifier = opinion_raid_capital target = root }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:CAS }
		c:CAS = {
			add_opinion = { modifier = opinion_raid_capital target = root }
		}
	}
}

# Apply Great Pestilence quarantine camps across owned American locations (standard or Asclepius Easter egg).
oe_elr_apply_pestilence_quarantine = {
	oe_elr_init_counters = yes
	if = {
		limit = { oe_elr_has_asclepius_seated = yes }
		set_variable = { name = oe_elr_quarantine_state value = 3 }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { continent = continent:america }
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_elr_asclepius_quarantine_loc_mod
				years = 15
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_elr_quarantine_state value = 2 }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { continent = continent:america }
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_elr_foederati_quarantine_loc_mod
				years = 15
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:NSM
			c:NSM = { country_type = pop }
		}
		c:NSM = {
			add_opinion = { modifier = opinion_good_relations target = root }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:TSN
			c:TSN = { country_type = pop }
		}
		c:TSN = {
			add_opinion = { modifier = opinion_good_relations target = root }
		}
	}
}

# Peaceful closure: Abandon Old World obsession & crown Independent Eternal Era of Nova Elysia.
oe_elr_proclaim_new_world_era = {
	oe_elr_init_counters = yes
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_elr_new_world_era_declared value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_elr_nostos_ended value = 2 }
	add_country_modifier = {
		modifier = oe_elr_new_world_eternal_era_mod
		years = -1
		mode = replace
	}
	add_stability = 10
	add_prestige = 20
	culture = {
		add_cultural_tradition = 15
	}
}

# Maintain true C++ twin-capital proximity radiation sources on Constantinople + Chesapeake/Nansemond.
oe_elr_maintain_twin_capitals = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:constantinople
			NOT = { location:constantinople = { has_location_modifier = oe_elr_twin_capital_east_mod } }
		}
		location:constantinople = {
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_elr_twin_capital_east_mod
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:chesapeake
			NOT = { location:chesapeake = { has_location_modifier = oe_elr_twin_capital_west_mod } }
		}
		location:chesapeake = {
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_elr_twin_capital_west_mod
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:nansemond
			NOT = { location:nansemond = { has_location_modifier = oe_elr_twin_capital_west_mod } }
		}
		location:nansemond = {
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_elr_twin_capital_west_mod
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
}

# Ending A1: Return of the Flame — Restore Capital to Constantinople & retain direct transatlantic rule.
oe_elr_apply_ending_return_direct = {
	oe_elr_init_counters = yes
	if = {
		limit = { owns = location:constantinople }
		set_capital = location:constantinople
	}
	change_country_name = BYZ
	change_country_adjective = BYZ_ADJ
	add_country_modifier = {
		modifier = oe_elr_return_flame_direct_mod
		years = -1
		mode = replace
	}
	set_variable = { name = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved value = 1 }
	oe_elr_set_nostos_stage = { STAGE = 4 }
	add_prestige = 30
	add_legitimacy = 20
}

# Ending A2: Return of the Flame — Restore Capital to Constantinople & charter Regnum Novae Elysiae Dominion.
oe_elr_apply_ending_return_viceroy = {
	oe_elr_init_counters = yes
	# Strictly move capital to Constantinople BEFORE creating American subject (SET_CAPITAL_FIRST safety).
	if = {
		limit = { owns = location:constantinople }
		set_capital = location:constantinople
	}
	change_country_name = BYZ
	change_country_adjective = BYZ_ADJ
	if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:constantinople
			capital = location:constantinople
			any_owned_location = { continent = continent:america }
		}
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { continent = continent:america }
			add_to_temporary_list = oe_elr_viceroy_locs
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owns = location:chesapeake }
			location:chesapeake = { save_scope_as = oe_elr_viceroy_cap }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owns = location:nansemond }
			location:nansemond = { save_scope_as = oe_elr_viceroy_cap }
		}
		else = {
			random_owned_location = {
				limit = { continent = continent:america }
				save_scope_as = oe_elr_viceroy_cap
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_elr_viceroy_cap }
			scope:oe_elr_viceroy_cap = {
				create_country_from_location = {
					locations = oe_elr_viceroy_locs
					overlord = root
					subject_type = subject_type:dominion
					save_scope_as = oe_elr_viceroy_realm
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:oe_elr_viceroy_realm }
				scope:oe_elr_viceroy_realm = {
					change_country_name = OE_REGNUM_NOVAE_ELYSIAE
					change_country_adjective = OE_REGNUM_NOVAE_ELYSIAE_ADJ
					add_country_modifier = {
						modifier = oe_elr_viceroy_elysia_mod
						years = -1
						mode = replace
					}
					every_owned_location = {
						add_core = scope:oe_elr_viceroy_realm
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	add_country_modifier = {
		modifier = oe_elr_return_flame_viceroy_mod
		years = -1
		mode = replace
	}
	set_variable = { name = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved value = 1 }
	oe_elr_set_nostos_stage = { STAGE = 4 }
	add_prestige = 30
	add_legitimacy = 20
}

# Ending B: Imperium Bicephalum — True Twin-Capital Transatlantic & Mediterranean Empire.
oe_elr_apply_ending_imperium_bicephalum = {
	oe_elr_init_counters = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_elr_imperium_bicephalum_unlocked value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_elr_is_bicephalum value = 1 }
	change_country_name = OE_IMPERIUM_BICEPHALUM
	change_country_adjective = OE_IMPERIUM_BICEPHALUM_ADJ
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_elr_ref_imperium_bicephalum } }
		add_reform = government_reform:oe_elr_ref_imperium_bicephalum
	}
	add_country_modifier = {
		modifier = oe_elr_imperium_bicephalum_mod
		years = -1
		mode = replace
	}
	oe_elr_maintain_twin_capitals = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved value = 2 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved value = 2 }
	oe_elr_set_nostos_stage = { STAGE = 4 }
	add_prestige = 35
	add_legitimacy = 20
}

# Path B Eternal City synergy: unlock European v9.8 Religio Romana deities upon reclaiming Rome.
oe_elr_unlock_eternal_city_pantheon = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = religion
			religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
		}
		oe_romp_ensure_omens_unlocked = yes
		oe_romp_unlock_god = { SHORT = sol_invictus }
		oe_romp_unlock_god = { SHORT = juno }
		oe_romp_unlock_god = { SHORT = vesta }
		oe_romp_unlock_god = { SHORT = asclepius }
		oe_romp_unlock_god = { SHORT = janus }
		oe_romp_unlock_god = { SHORT = apollo }
		oe_romp_unlock_god = { SHORT = isis_serapis }
		oe_romp_unlock_god = { SHORT = quirinus_mars }
		oe_romp_unlock_god = { SHORT = mithras }
		oe_romp_unlock_god = { SHORT = cybele }
	}
}

# Slot 74 monthly pulse dispatcher (O(1) early exit when not settled / before 1480 / AI / rebel).
oe_elr_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			is_rebel_country = no
			oe_elr_is_elysia_host = yes
			OR = {
				current_year >= 1495
				has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared
				oe_elr_great_pestilence_active = yes
			}
		}
		oe_elr_init_counters = yes

		# Keep Imperium Bicephalum twin-capital proximity cores intact if Ending B is active.
		if = {
			limit = { var:oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved ?= 2 }
			oe_elr_maintain_twin_capitals = yes
		}

		# Priority 1: Act IV Reclaim Constantinople / Rome & Grand Dual Ending chain.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared
				owns = location:constantinople
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev16_fired }
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev16_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.16
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_elr_ev16_fired
				owns = location:constantinople
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev18_fired }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved }
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev18_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.18
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev19_fired }
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev19_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.19
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared
				owns = location:rome
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev17_fired }
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev17_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.17
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_new_world_era_declared }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev14_fired }
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev14_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.14
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared
				has_variable = oe_elr_ev14_fired
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_new_world_era_declared }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev15_fired }
				oe_elr_has_mediterranean_foothold = yes
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev15_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.15
		}
		# Priority 2: Great Pestilence Byzantine Quarantine Chain (oe_elr.9 -> .10 -> .11).
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				oe_elr_great_pestilence_active = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev9_fired }
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev9_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.9
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_elr_ev9_fired
				oe_elr_great_pestilence_active = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev10_fired }
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev10_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_elr_ev10_fired
				NOT = { oe_elr_great_pestilence_active = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev11_fired }
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev11_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.11
		}
		# Priority 3: Act III Atlantic Hegemony & Old World Confrontation Chain (1495+).
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1495
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev1_fired }
				oe_elr_any_old_world_power_in_america = yes
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev1_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.1
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_elr_ev1_fired
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev2_fired }
				oe_elr_iberian_in_caribbean = yes
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev2_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.2
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1530
				has_variable = oe_elr_ev2_fired
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev3_fired }
				oe_elr_iberian_in_caribbean = yes
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev3_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.3
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owns = location:habana
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev4_fired }
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev4_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.4
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_elr_ev1_fired
				owns = location:manhattan
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev5_fired }
				oe_elr_northern_rival_present = yes
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev5_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1515
				owns = location:manhattan
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev6_fired }
				OR = {
					country_exists = c:IRO
					country_exists = c:STD
					country_exists = c:OSG
				}
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev6_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.6
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1520
				has_variable = oe_elr_ev1_fired
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev7_fired }
				OR = {
					location:tenochtitlan = { has_owner = yes }
					location:qusqu = { has_owner = yes }
				}
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev7_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.7
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1530
				current_year <= 1660
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev8_fired }
				oe_elr_europe_religious_war_active = yes
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev8_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.8
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev12_fired }
				oe_elr_atlantic_mastery_met = yes
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev12_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.12
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_elr_ev12_fired
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev13_fired }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_new_world_era_declared }
				NOT = { owns = location:constantinople }
				oe_elr_nostos_thresholds_met = yes
			}
			set_variable = oe_elr_ev13_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.13
		}
	}
}
